title: CU: Rhys's six first-day smoke checks after verified 146
public_pr_body:
Adds tests/FIRST-DAY-SMOKE-CHECK.md: login, one approved check job, draft quote, timesheet, prepared controlled chase draft and AI off. Each has clicks, expected result, stop rule and unticked result/evidence box. Preserves JNR unpaid breaks, normal numbering, drafts/no sends and no 146 reinstall after rollback.

Real UI scope checked: Chase All Overdue drafts every eligible overdue invoice, so the sheet requires an approved prepared check draft instead of pretending there is a safe one-invoice test button. No genuine staff hours, imported work or customer sends are manufactured. Six passes are not full validation or operational release authority.

Checks: six complete rows, actual action scope, release sequence and stop rules reviewed. Documentation only, no SQL/data/mail action, main merge, Ready label or duplicate docs/signoff paper.

- [x] Short six-check smoke list with concrete expected/stop results
- [ ] Rhys runs the approved checks with Code after actual release verification

CR follow-through: exact reviewed #314 wording is now retained here (CN blocks external AI on restored real data and limits export checks to Xero; CU requires actual admin MFA challenge and scopes AI-off evidence). Current head 78dc5b7033592f20640b15e61b198c7fcf17930e. These documentation corrections were made after CV's frozen test snapshot; no new runtime pass is claimed.
